matching: Within the same case/window, target ordinal > origin, target interval start >= origin end; nearest start to origin end + horizon, ties earlier; absolute start error <= 0.05 seconds. No resampling, gap bridging between windows, or target reuse deduplication. Report realized start/end leads.

long_night.population: all for variance_rad2 and source_std; lk_valid for disagreement_rad
long_night.controls: Covariance carry-forward absolute log error versus zero-change is reported directly; disagreement persistence is an oracle diagnostic requiring LK, not deployable independent ground truth. No p-values or effective-independent-sample claims.
long_night.reporting: Each of six modality-window cases separately; correlation masks finite per comparison. Log requires strictly positive. Preserve tiny-support RGB counts.

gate.population: 274 original decisions. Temporal matching performed before any feature/label eligibility. Future-relative-quality comparisons require origin eligible and target both-supported with both finite proxy losses; current proxy labels also finite for matched oracle comparison.
gate.current: lag0 log1p(median trace) RGB minus thermal, exactly the inherited EXP091 transform; raw pixel units retained, not calibrated cross-camera risk.
gate.history: fixed arithmetic mean of all three lag log1p trace gaps, no fitting
targets: future RGB squared translation proxy loss minus thermal squared translation proxy loss
future RGB squared rotation proxy loss minus thermal squared rotation proxy loss
gate.controls: current respective squared-loss gap -> future gap is an oracle persistence diagnostic, unavailable online as physical truth
gate.reporting: Each recording/window separately; no pooled window correlation or architecture selection

timing_limit: Observation-interval times, not measured neural completion/deadline times. Gate common intervals do not certify physical exposure or compute latency. No achieved pre-inference latency claim.
pre_execution_clarification: Source inspection confirms EXP091 feature named log_median_trace actually uses log1p. Preserve its exact coordinates. No new outcome calculation had run at clarification.
